Top Stories.title: 160 electric detonators found near Army camp in Secunderabad; unrelated to arms theft case, say police
Top Stories.summary: Security forces and local police in Secunderabad are investigating the recovery of 160 electric detonators discovered near a military installation. The devices were reportedly stumbled upon near the Army camp’s golf course, a discovery that naturally raised alarms given the sensitivity of the area. However, authorities have been quick to clarify that this incident appears to have no connection to recent reports regarding stolen arms. Preliminary investigations suggest that the detonators were likely discarded or forgotten during construction activities for a private venture situated adjacent to the golf course property. While the nature of the materials is inherently dangerous, the police are treating this as an issue of improper disposal at a construction site rather than a deliberate act of sabotage or a security breach linked to the aforementioned theft case. The recovery highlights the potential risks associated with construction debris in proximity to high-security defense zones. Officials are continuing to examine how such sensitive blasting materials ended up abandoned in an open area and are ensuring that all safety protocols are followed to clear the site of any further hazardous equipment, thereby calming public anxiety regarding the security of the military cantonment.

Top Stories.title: Rahul Gandhi will help Tamil Nadu CM Vijay become Prime Minister in 2029: TVK MLA
Top Stories.summary: In a bold political statement, Tamil Nadu politician Kanimozhi Santhosh has articulated a vision for the future of the state's leadership and national aspirations. As an MLA representing the Tamizhaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK), Kanimozhi Santhosh expressed confidence that the bond between Congress leader Rahul Gandhi and actor-turned-politician Vijay is destined for greater things on the national stage. She pointed to a perceived role Rahul Gandhi played in Vijay’s rise to the Chief Minister's office, characterizing it as a pivotal influence. Looking toward the horizon, she projected that this political partnership would evolve significantly by the time the 2029 general elections arrive. According to her, the transition from state-level influence to federal governance is the next step for their leader. She claimed that Rahul Gandhi would act as a mentor or guide, metaphorically holding Vijay’s hand to facilitate his ascension to the Prime Minister’s chair. This statement underscores the growing ambition of the TVK and hints at an evolving alliance structure within Indian opposition politics, positioning Vijay not just as a regional leader in Tamil Nadu, but as a serious contender for the highest office in the country within the next five years.

Top Stories.title: IndiGo Doha-Bengaluru flight diverted to Muscat after pilot falls ill
Top Stories.summary: An IndiGo flight traveling from Doha to Bengaluru experienced a mid-air medical emergency that forced a sudden change in its flight path. The flight, designated as 6E 1302, departed from Doha in the early hours of the morning at approximately 2:19 a.m. During the journey, a member of the flight crew fell ill, necessitating immediate intervention to ensure both the safety of the individual and the passengers on board. Following protocol, the pilot made the decision to divert the aircraft to Muscat, landing safely at 5:30 a.m. local time. Upon touchdown, the ailing crew member was met by a specialized medical team stationed at the Muscat airport, who provided necessary assistance and evaluation. Such diversions are standard precautionary measures in the aviation industry when crew members are incapacitated, as the health of those operating the aircraft is paramount to maintaining flight safety. While such occurrences cause significant disruption to the travel schedules of those on board, the priority remains the well-being of the personnel and the secure arrival of the flight. The airline has worked to manage the situation and ensure the affected staff member receives proper care, highlighting the rigorous emergency preparedness that governs commercial air travel.

Top Stories.title: Supreme Court asks Prashant Bhushan to approach Delhi High Court in case of lawyers beaten at BCI premises
Top Stories.summary: The Supreme Court of India recently addressed a plea concerning the physical assault of lawyers at the Bar Council of India (BCI) premises, ultimately directing the petitioner to seek legal recourse through the appropriate channel. Advocate Prashant Bhushan appeared before a Bench led by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant to raise the issue of the violent incident involving legal professionals. Mr. Bhushan explained that he had opted to bring the matter directly to the Supreme Court because the apex court is already overseeing several other petitions related to the Bar Council of India. He argued that the current context of ongoing litigation made the top court the most suitable venue for addressing the safety concerns of the affected lawyers. However, the Bench determined that it was procedurally inappropriate to circumvent the lower courts in this instance. Consequently, the Court instructed Mr. Bhushan to approach the Delhi High Court instead. This decision underscores the judiciary's adherence to established jurisdictional hierarchies, even when matters pertain to organizations that are already the subject of scrutiny at higher levels of the legal system, ensuring that procedural order is maintained while still allowing the grievance to be heard in a competent court.

Top Stories.title: Raghav Chadha claims his name marked ‘shifted’ in Punjab draft rolls at AAP’s behest
Top Stories.summary: A public dispute has erupted between AAP leader Raghav Chadha and his own party regarding the status of his voter registration in Punjab. Mr. Chadha raised significant concerns after discovering that his name had been marked as 'shifted' within the official draft voter rolls of the state. He alleged that this administrative change occurred at the express behest of the Aam Aadmi Party, suggesting a targeted effort to remove his voting rights or change his constituency status. In response to these claims, the Aam Aadmi Party has vehemently denied any wrongdoing, shifting the focus of the controversy back onto Mr. Chadha. The party accused him of attempting to manipulate the process to secure voter registration in Delhi, alleging that he was employing a 'backdated process' to facilitate this move. This internal friction, playing out in the public eye, highlights a deeper tension within the party organization and points to the complexities of voter enrollment laws, which strictly forbid improper attempts to shift residency status. The dispute now revolves around the legitimacy of Mr. Chadha's actions versus the motivations of the party, creating a contentious narrative regarding electoral transparency and internal party governance within the AAP.

Top Stories.title: Supreme Court declines to entertain plea challenging curbs on journalists’, activists’ entry into U.P., Rajasthan schools
Top Stories.summary: The Supreme Court of India has officially turned down a plea that sought to challenge the restrictions imposed on journalists and activists regarding their entry into government schools located in Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan. This legal challenge emerged directly in the wake of the 'School Thik Karo' campaign, an initiative launched by Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP). The primary objective of this campaign was to conduct audits of government-run schools in rural regions to address and ultimately improve the dilapidated infrastructure plaguing these institutions. By seeking entry, activists and media personnel intended to document the ground realities of these facilities, hoping to bring systemic neglect to light. The court’s decision to decline the plea effectively maintains the current status quo, preventing these external parties from entering school premises for the purposes of their investigation. The matter is significant because it touches upon the ongoing tension between administrative control over government institutions and the necessity for public transparency and accountability in the education sector. Critics argue that these curbs limit the ability of the public and the press to hold local governments responsible for the maintenance and quality of essential rural infrastructure.

Top Stories.title: Civil Police Officer in Kozhikode suspended for 'misusing’ official position during spa visit
Top Stories.summary: In a case highlighting allegations of professional misconduct, a Civil Police Officer stationed in Kozhikode has been placed under suspension following an internal inquiry into his behavior during a visit to a local spa. The investigation concluded that the officer had accessed various spa services without settling the bill, essentially exploiting his status for personal gain. Beyond the accusation of receiving complimentary services, the officer is also facing serious allegations of extortion. It is reported that he demanded money from the spa operators, claiming that these funds were required to be passed on to a senior superior officer. He allegedly suggested that such payments were a necessary condition for the spa to continue its operations without any interference from the police. This incident has raised concerns regarding the misuse of power and the corruption that can occur at the local enforcement level. The suspension serves as a disciplinary measure while authorities determine the extent of his actions and whether any higher-ranking officials were truly involved or if the officer was simply using their name as a pretense to extract bribes from local businesses.

Top Stories.title: Delhi Police detains ex-bureaucrat over online activity, releases him later
Top Stories.summary: Delhi Police recently detained a former bureaucrat in a brief but noteworthy incident that took place at Nehru Park. According to reports, the man was approached by two individuals dressed in plain clothes who instructed him to accompany them to the Special Cell’s office located in the New Friends Colony area. The nature of the interaction stemmed from concerns regarding the former bureaucrat’s recent online activity. While the circumstances surrounding his detention appeared sudden and unconventional, he was eventually released by the authorities after the initial questioning process concluded. The Special Cell of the Delhi Police is a specialized unit often tasked with handling sensitive matters, and this involvement suggests that the individual's digital footprints or public commentary caught the attention of law enforcement officials monitoring potential security concerns or regulatory violations. The incident highlights the growing scrutiny on the online behavior of former government officials and the swiftness with which specialized police units operate when they identify activity that they deem suspicious or warranting a formal inquiry. The individual was allowed to depart following the completion of the police's administrative procedures regarding the matter.

Top Stories.title: Woman found murdered, man attempts suicide inside Delhi hotel room: Police
Top Stories.summary: A group of lawyers recently organized a protest situated outside the Bar Council of India (BCI) headquarters, calling for the immediate resignation of its chairman, Manan Kumar Mishra. The demonstration was sparked by a growing controversy surrounding the National Academy of Legal Studies and Research (NALSAR). Central to the protesters' grievances is the tenure of the current chairman, which has spanned an impressive 14 years. The lawyers argue that such a prolonged period in a singular position of power is detrimental to the organization and stifles the necessary evolution of the legal body. Furthermore, the demonstrators are pushing for comprehensive reforms within the BCI’s internal election mechanism, suggesting that the current processes are outdated or lack sufficient democratic accountability. This protest marks a significant point of internal friction within the legal fraternity, as members demand greater transparency and a structural overhaul of the institutions that govern them. The agitation reflects a broader desire among segments of the legal community to see fresh leadership and updated organizational practices that better align with modern standards of governance and representation for lawyers across the country.

Top Stories.title: Lawyers stage protest outside BCI office, seek chairman’s resignation amid NALSAR row
Top Stories.summary: A tragic discovery was made inside a hotel room in Delhi when staff members found a woman deceased and a man suffering from what appeared to be a self-inflicted attempt at suicide. The incident came to light after hotel personnel grew concerned that the guests were not responding to repeated attempts to open the door, prompting them to check on the room. Upon gaining access, they encountered the grim scene and immediately alerted the local police authorities to the situation. Law enforcement officials have since secured the area to conduct a forensic investigation to determine the exact sequence of events that led to the woman’s death and the man's physical condition. The case is being handled by the police, who are currently collecting evidence from the room and questioning the hotel staff to piece together the background of the two individuals. This incident highlights the sudden and often private nature of such tragedies occurring in urban hospitality settings, and it brings focus to the police’s ongoing efforts to uncover the motives or relationships between the victims that may have culminated in this fatal confrontation and the subsequent attempt to end another life.

Technology.title: YAM Finance Hit by Governance Attack, $337,000 in Assets Exposed
Technology.summary: YAM Finance faces a potential governance takeover after an attacker accumulated enough voting power to submit a proposal targeting the protocol’s Timelock. If approved and executed, the proposal could give the attacker administrative control over YAM contracts and the DAO treasury. About $337,000 (roughly Rs. 3.1 crore) in assets could be exposed, though no treasury funds had been lost when the warning was issued.

Technology.title: Perplexity Launches Hybrid Compute Feature for Mac to Keep Sensitive Data Local
Technology.summary: Perplexity announced the Hybrid Compute feature. This lets users work with AI on data without the information leaving their device by dividing each task between the cloud and a local model on their Mac. A privacy gate on the Mac controls what information leaves the machine. This feature is now available to Perplexity Pro, Max, and Enterprise subscribers.

Top Stories.title: पायलट की तबीयत बिगड़ने पर दोहा-बेंगलुरु फ्लाइट मस्कट डायवर्ट:अस्पताल ले गए, अब ठीक; यात्रियों को लेने बेंगलुरु से दूसरी फ्लाइट भेजी
Top Stories.summary: दोहा से बेंगलुरु के लिए उड़ान भरने वाली इंडिगो की एक फ्लाइट के साथ गुरुवार को एक अप्रत्याशित घटना घटी, जब विमान के पायलट की अचानक तबीयत बिगड़ गई। आपातकालीन स्थिति को देखते हुए सुरक्षा प्रोटोकॉल का पालन करते हुए फ्लाइट को तुरंत मस्कट की ओर मोड़ दिया गया। पायलट की सुरक्षित लैंडिंग के बाद उन्हें तत्काल चिकित्सा सहायता के लिए स्थानीय अस्पताल में भर्ती कराया गया, जहां एयरलाइंस के अनुसार वे अब खतरे से बाहर हैं और उनकी स्थिति स्थिर बताई जा रही है। इस घटना के कारण यात्रियों को काफी असुविधा का सामना करना पड़ा क्योंकि उन्हें अपनी मंजिल तक पहुँचने के लिए काफी देर तक इंतजार करना पड़ा। यात्रियों की सुरक्षा और सुविधा को प्राथमिकता देते हुए, इंडिगो एयरलाइन ने बेंगलुरु से मस्कट के लिए एक विशेष राहत विमान और नए चालक दल के सदस्यों को भेजा ताकि वे प्रभावित यात्रियों को सुरक्षित उनके गंतव्य तक पहुँचा सकें। विमानन क्षेत्र में इस तरह की घटनाएं अक्सर चिंता का विषय होती हैं, लेकिन एयरलाइन का त्वरित निर्णय और समय पर की गई वैकल्पिक व्यवस्था यात्रियों की सुरक्षा के प्रति उनकी प्रतिबद्धता को दर्शाती है। अब स्थिति पूरी तरह नियंत्रण में है और प्रभावित सभी यात्री अपनी यात्रा पूरी करने की प्रक्रिया में हैं।

Top Stories.title: सारा और शुभमन कर रहे एक-दूसरे को गुपचुप डेट! होशियारी दिखाकर भी एक सबूत छोड़ गए पीछे
Top Stories.summary: भारतीय क्रिकेट टीम के स्टार बल्लेबाज शुभमन गिल और सारा तेंदुलकर के बीच कथित रिश्तों को लेकर सोशल मीडिया पर एक बार फिर चर्चाओं का बाजार गर्म हो गया है। हालांकि दोनों ही हस्तियों ने हमेशा सार्वजनिक रूप से अपने संबंधों पर चुप्पी साधे रखी है, लेकिन इंटरनेट यूजर्स और उनके प्रशंसक उनके हर छोटे कदम पर बारीकी से नजर रखते हैं। हाल ही में सारा तेंदुलकर द्वारा शुभमन गिल की बहन शाहनील गिल को सोशल मीडिया पर फॉलो करने की खबर ने इन कयासों को नया मोड़ दे दिया है। इसके अलावा, एक पुराने वीडियो के अचानक वायरल होने से भी फैंस को फिर से उन पुरानी बातों को जोड़ने का मौका मिल गया है, जो पहले भी सुर्खियों में रही थीं। हालांकि ये सभी संकेत केवल सोशल मीडिया गतिविधियों पर आधारित हैं और इनकी कोई आधिकारिक पुष्टि नहीं की गई है, फिर भी लोग इसे एक बड़े सबूत के रूप में देख रहे हैं। मनोरंजन और खेल जगत में सितारों की निजी जिंदगी हमेशा चर्चा का विषय रही है और यह मामला भी उसी का एक हिस्सा है, जहां प्रशंसकों की जिज्ञासा कम होने का नाम नहीं ले रही है। फिलहाल ये सभी अटकलें केवल कयासों के दायरे में ही हैं।

Top Stories.title: दिल्ली: रोहिणी में नाबालिग छात्रा से छेड़छाड़, विरोध करने पर पीड़िता और मां-दादी पर हमला, एफआईआर दर्ज
Top Stories.summary: दिल्ली के रोहिणी इलाके से एक बेहद चिंताजनक मामला सामने आया है, जहां एक नाबालिग छात्रा के साथ छेड़छाड़ की घटना ने हड़कंप मचा दिया है। मिली जानकारी के अनुसार, जब छात्रा ने इस अनुचित व्यवहार का कड़ा विरोध किया, तो आरोपी ने पीड़िता और उसके बचाव में आई मां और दादी पर हमला कर दिया, जिससे क्षेत्र में भय और गुस्से का माहौल है। यह घटना महिलाओं की सुरक्षा के प्रति गंभीर सवाल खड़े करती है, खासकर जब अपराध घर के पास और सार्वजनिक स्थानों के करीब हो रहे हों। स्थानीय पुलिस ने इस मामले को गंभीरता से लेते हुए पीड़िता के परिवार की शिकायत पर तत्काल प्रभाव से एफआईआर दर्ज कर ली है। फिलहाल पुलिस टीम मौके पर साक्ष्य जुटाने में लगी है और सीसीटीवी फुटेज के जरिए आरोपियों की पहचान की कोशिश की जा रही है ताकि उन्हें जल्द से जल्द कानून के दायरे में लाया जा सके। इस तरह की घटनाएं समाज के लिए शर्मनाक हैं और अपराधियों में कानून का डर कायम रखना प्रशासन के लिए एक बड़ी चुनौती बन गई है। उम्मीद है कि पुलिस इस मामले में निष्पक्ष जांच करेगी और पीड़ित परिवार को न्याय दिलाने के लिए आरोपियों के खिलाफ सख्त दंडात्मक कार्रवाई सुनिश्चित करेगी।
